purpose: Content-addressed records for bulky research evidence. Externalized artifacts are deliberately NOT carried in the mainline tree; their bytes remain retrievable from the immutable git history at the producer commit. In-tree evidence that is required by runtime tests is pinned here too so every large evidence file has a content-addressed record. No external artifact may exist without a pinned hash in this registry.

policy.in_git_tree: source code, tests, contracts, schemas, manifests, preregistrations, final_report.md, small final_report.json, hash pointers, and any evidence required by runtime tests
policy.externalized: bulky replay ledgers and large intermediate evidence not required by runtime tests; bytes preserved at the producer commit (git object database) and regenerable deterministically by the producer script
policy.verification: scripts/verify_external_artifacts.py recomputes sha256 of the bytes at each storage location (git:<commit>:<path> or tree:<path>) and fails closed on any mismatch
